title: Reference approach: Monte Carlo Simulation Engine
approach: Validate external input shape, dtype, and fields before numerical work.
Use ndarray operations and choose explicit axes and tolerance rules.
Separate loading, transformation, analysis, and reporting into testable functions.
Use synthetic fixtures and test invalid/boundary cases.
Record assumptions, environment versions, and performance measurements.
acceptance_guidance: Configure a seed, distribution, trial count, and batch size.
Run repeated samples and summarize the estimate.
Compare results as sample count changes.
Document reproducibility scope and memory/runtime trade-offs.
explanation: Build a configurable simulation that estimates a quantity using seeded random sampling and reports uncertainty. This is a reference approach, not a complete executable deliverable. Final reference code and tests require technical review before release.
